steps.name: event-socket-generalization
steps.summary: Chose GENERALIZATION (no duplication fallback needed: `@MainActor @Observable final class EventSocket<Event: SocketEvent, Message: SocketMessage>` compiles clean under Swift 6.2 strict concurrency). New `ios/MacAgent/Networking/EventSocket.swift`: `SocketEvent`/`SocketMessage` protocols, `SocketEndpoint` (`.session(id:)`, `.room(teamId:roomId:)`, notFoundCloseCode 4004 + reason), `SocketPolicy` (pingInterval 20s, maxBackoff 30, jitter 300, `backoffDelay`), generic `EventSocket` (state machine, since=lastSeq reconnect, lastSeq only for seq>0, pong consumed, ping loop, 4004 → closed(reason) no reconnect; `disconnect()` now also finishes the events stream per spec), `typealias SessionSocket`/`RoomSocket` with convenience inits in constrained extensions, legacy statics (`pingInterval`, `pingText`, `backoffDelay`, `closeCodeSessionNotFound`, `sessionNotFoundReason`) kept as computed members, plus `ServerEvent`/`RoomEvent: SocketEvent` and `ClientMessage`/`RoomClientMessage: SocketMessage` extensions. `SessionSocket.swift` trimmed to transport layer only (`WebSocketTransport`, `SocketError`, `URLSessionWebSocketTransport`). New `ios/MacAgentTests/Networking/RoomSocketTests.swift` (10 tests: room URL `/api/v1/teams/<t>/rooms/<r>/ws?since=<n>`, snapshot(0)+message(3) → lastSeq 3, session frames ignored, reconnect since=3 with 1/2/4s backoff, policy equal to SessionSocket, 4004 → closed("방이 없습니다"), other codes reconnect, room.send/room.interrupt/ping match fixtures, disconnect finishes stream). `SessionSocketTests.swift`, `TimelineModel.swift`, `FakeWebSocketTransport.swift` untouched. AC: xcodegen generate + xcodebuild test green (iOS 274 tests, 0 failures, no warnings in touched files), git diff on SessionSocketTests clean, RoomSocket grep OK, `bash scripts/test.sh` OK (TS 754 passed). No fixtures/docs/phases files changed.

Tests first (RED confirmed): RoomModelTests (24), MentionParserTests (13), MemberStatusTests (4). AC: xcodegen+xcodebuild test exit 0 with 0 warnings in new files, files exist, bash scripts/test.sh OK (TS 754 passed). No existing files, fixtures, docs, or phases/ changed.

steps.name: approval-banner-generalization
steps.summary: Generalized the approval banner/sheets over a new `ApprovalResponding` protocol (Features/Approvals/ApprovalResponding.swift: `@MainActor protocol ApprovalResponding: AnyObject, Observable` with pendingApprovals/approvalSubmit/respond(to:optionId:inputs:message:)/authorLabel defaulting nil; `TimelineModel` bare conformance). `RoomModel` conforms in RoomModel.swift: stored list renamed `pendingApprovals: [RoomApproval]` → `pendingRoomApprovals` (Swift can't overload a property by type), protocol `pendingApprovals` = `pendingRoomApprovals.map(\.approval)` (requestedAt order kept), `respond(to: Approval…)` finds the RoomApproval by approvalId and delegates to the step 2 REST respond, `authorLabel` = "emoji name · roleLabel" (nil if not pending or members unknown). `ApprovalBanner`/`ApprovalSheet`/`ApprovalDetailForm`/`PendingApprovalsSheet` now take `any ApprovalResponding`; banner shows one `.caption .secondary` author line above the title only when authorLabel exists, all other layout/text/identifiers unchanged. `ItemCard` now stores `CardChrome { status, createdAt, summary }` with `init(chrome:…)`; `init(item:…)` builds the chrome via `ItemAccessibility.summary` and delegates (other card files untouched). `ApprovalCard` renders new `ApprovalCardBody(approval:resolution:onShowDetail:)` (owns resolutionLabel; ApprovalCard.resolutionLabel forwards), visuals identical. Tests first: new ApprovalRespondingTests (6: requestedAt order, POST /sessions/<sessionId>/approvals/<approvalId> via StubURLProtocol, unknown approval ignored, authorLabel "🧑‍💻 지연 · 개발자", nil without members, TimelineModel nil) and ItemCardChromeTests (3: chrome equals ItemAccessibility.summary, nil for messages, chrome init keeps values); RoomModelTests only mechanically renamed to pendingRoomApprovals; ApprovalBannerLogicTests and other approval tests unchanged. AC: xcodegen generate + xcodebuild test green (iOS 326 tests: 323 passed, 0 failed, 3 UI skipped; 0 warnings in touched files), file/grep checks OK, bash scripts/test.sh OK (TS 754 passed). TimelineModel.swift, fixtures, docs, phases/ untouched.
